name: How should I prepare my kitchen before drywall repair professionals arrive?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before drywall repair professionals arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the crew arrives, clear your kitchen countertops, empty lower or upper cabinets adjacent to the repair zone, and remove fragile items from nearby shelves. Drywall cutting and sanding generate fine dust, so establishing clear workspace access is essential. Take photos of the damage if it involves an insurance claim from plumbing or storm issues, and identify your original wall paint brand, color name, and sheen if you have leftover cans stored. Clearing a pathway from the exterior entry to the kitchen allows technicians to bring in dust barriers, drop cloths, ladders, and taping tools efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear countertops, empty cabinets near the work zone, store fragile items, and locate any leftover touch-up paint. Creating a clean pathway helps technicians set up containment barriers quickly.
